description: Edit a Klaviyo campaign that is still a DRAFT: name, subject, previewText, fromEmail, fromLabel, replyTo, templateId, or its audience (listIds / segmentIds / excludeIds). A scheduled one must be reverted first (cancel_klaviyo_campaign). Read back. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Settings > Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).
name: update_klaviyo_campaign
title: Update a Klaviyo campaign draft
